scenes.label: Vision
scenes.title: A whole cultural ecosystem.
scenes.body: Indigen World brings language preservation, learning, storytelling, creators and community-governed heritage together. Project Kassena is the first Kasem language cell.
scenes.limit: Three public products plus internal administration. Other language cells remain an ambition.

scenes.label: The loop
scenes.title: Discovery becomes contribution.
scenes.body: People find language and culture, contribute with context and permissions, receive review and corrections, then use eligible published knowledge to learn and create.
scenes.limit: Everyday non-campaign posts use a separate open-publication route with reactive moderation.

scenes.label: Evidence
scenes.title: Every claim needs its own proof.
scenes.body: This bounded review covers 47 curated capabilities across 13 domains. Source code, tests, release receipts and user outcomes answer different questions.
scenes.limit: These inventory counts are not a completion score. Historical test results were not rerun in this audit.

scenes.label: Next proof
scenes.title: Close the trust and release gaps.
scenes.body: Start with the generic export clearance gap and environment isolation. Prove a signed-in contribution journey, current Play distribution and real-device behavior.
scenes.limit: HTTP page reachability does not prove authenticated behavior, permissions or production readiness.

scenes.label: Community
scenes.title: Let authority and outcomes guide growth.
scenes.body: Qualified reviewers, explicit source rights, finance and support capacity, and independent learner evidence make the next language cell and future voice models credible.
scenes.limit: Retrieval and third-party AI assistance do not establish a trained production Kasem model.
